class.name: motkin_ros2_hardware_interface/SystemPicoDualDrv8316CHardware
class.description: Drives a dual-motor testbed (2 joints) over the USB-CDC binary protocol exposed by the pico_dual_PMSM_BUG79100G_DRV8316C firmware. Each joint exposes position/velocity/effort/gain_kp/gain_kd command and state interfaces matching the board's PD + current-feedforward control law.
